posts.text: Americans are concerned about inflation. Only 8% of US consumers expect their income to grow faster than inflation over the next year, the lowest proportion in at least 2 years. This figure has declined -10 percentage points since November 2024. At the same time, 20% anticipate their income to grow at roughly the same pace as inflation, near the lowest proportion since at least July 2024. This means 72% of consumers expect inflation to outpace their income over the next year, the highest reading in at least 2 years. By comparison, this figure stood at 58% in November 2024. Americans are extremely pessimistic about their real purchasing power.
posts.author: KobeissiLetter
